answer.rationale: Prioritize an accelerated incumbent negotiation using the low-cost quote as leverage, targeting the mandated 18% spend reduction plus improved payment terms. This retains proven integration and scheduled-delivery continuity while the line has virtually no volume buffer. The low-cost vendor is a credible fallback because its quote meets the mandate, but switching primary supply immediately would introduce delivery/onboarding risk at the most operationally sensitive moment. Verify the prior negotiation record before committing because whether the incumbent can credibly meet the reduction remains uncertain.
